text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which 
 must be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above 
 titled block.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 01 July 2003, accepted by by General Manager eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag, 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector
Technical Specifications
Manufacturer | Siemens.
Type | Fan.
Suction Pressure | 1.1bar.
Discharge Pressure | 2bars.
Safety Precautions
Issue Work order including the teamwork names.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Tools and Equipment
Cleaning articles.
Special cleaning materials.
Spray gun. - Set of wrenches.
Grease gun.
Work to be Carried Out
Drain the oil collected in the pipes at 
 regular intervals, however at least every one month.
Inspect van and bearing grease, and grease them if it is required [ 
 grease type is Cup-grease].
